*Start monitoring, show the last session report, and run the tray
application.*

- `snooper_pkg.config` is imported as `cf` but is not used anywhere in

- The wildcard tray import hides which tray APIs this module depends on.
  The current code uses
  [`open_last_session_report`](https://sayanbanerjee32.github.io/snooper_pkg/tray.html#open_last_session_report)

- The exported `if __name__ == "__main__":` cell may call
  [`main()`](https://sayanbanerjee32.github.io/snooper_pkg/main.html#main)
  when executed interactively because notebook kernels commonly set
  `__name__` to `"__main__"`. Confirm that launching the application
  during a notebook “Run All” is intended.

  transitively imports Windows-only modules such as `win32gui`. The
  notebook therefore cannot currently be executed in this non-Windows
